--- exists_braced_match.sql
GRAPH FinGraph
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN EXISTS {
  MATCH (p)-[:Owns]->(a:Account)
} AS has_account

                        &ast.GQLTopLevelPathPattern{

--- SQL
GRAPH FinGraph MATCH (p:Person) RETURN EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:Owns]->(a:Account) } AS has_account
